name: 31320 · Midway, GA
findings: ZIP 31320 (Midway) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 31320 (Midway) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 31320 (Midway) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
